task: Expose explicit selected-tenant context controls in platform operations surfaces while consuming the existing canonical tenant authority.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This transaction exposes a privileged context-selection capability in platform operations UI. It must not duplicate tenant authority, accept arbitrary targets, or obscure the active operating context.

acceptanceCriteria: Platform control center and managed-instance list expose an explicit action for eligible pilot/active tenants.
The server action revalidates current platform operator authority and exact target eligibility before invoking the canonical tenant-context setter.
The platform shell displays the currently selected tenant name whenever a platform actor is operating inside a tenant context.
A clear-context action returns the actor to the tenant-independent platform control center.
Suspended or archived targets are not presented as enterable tenant contexts.
No customer authentication, pilot acceptance or AAL2 policy is changed.
invariants: UI and server actions consume tenant-context-authority; they do not implement a second tenant resolver.
Target instance ids are validated server-side and eligibility is queried from canonical data.
The active context is visibly identified before tenant-scoped operations.
Clearing context removes only the platform tenant selection and does not sign the user out.

failureModes: A forged form target bypasses instance eligibility validation.
The platform actor enters a tenant but the shell does not indicate which tenant is active.
A presentation shortcut sets cookies directly instead of using the canonical tenancy capability.
The clear action mutates authentication instead of operating context.
edgeCases: Pilot and active tenants expose entry actions.
Suspended and archived tenants remain visible but are not enterable.
A platform actor with selected context can return to platform-global operations without logout.
Invalid target ids return to platform management with a bounded error state.

alternatives.summary: Carry the selected tenant only in query parameters on every platform navigation.
alternatives.reason: Query state is client-controlled, leaks into links, and would force presentation surfaces to become tenant authority.

alternatives.summary: Set the tenant cookie directly from presentation components.
alternatives.reason: This duplicates authority and bypasses server-side target eligibility checks.

alternatives.summary: Use a thin platform server action to validate the target and invoke the canonical tenancy setter/clearer.
alternatives.reason: This keeps UI orchestration in DOMAIN-ADMIN while tenant truth remains in DOMAIN-TENANCY.

specialistReviews.finding: Platform UI may orchestrate tenant selection but cannot own context truth.
specialistReviews.resolution: context-actions.ts validates the requested target and delegates storage to src/lib/instances/platform-tenant-context.ts.

specialistReviews.finding: A hidden instanceId submitted from the browser is untrusted and must not directly set context.
specialistReviews.resolution: The action validates UUID syntax, requires current platform authority, queries the exact instance, and allows only pilot/active status before delegating.

challenge.scenario: A user modifies the hidden instanceId before submitting the selection form.
challenge.finding: Client input could target an arbitrary tenant.
challenge.resolution: The server action validates UUID and exact canonical instance eligibility before setting context.

challenge.scenario: A platform actor selects a tenant and later navigates to another operations page.
challenge.finding: Without visible context, cross-tenant mistakes become more likely.
challenge.resolution: The shared platform shell shows the active tenant label whenever an instance is selected.

challenge.scenario: The actor wants to resume global platform work without ending the authenticated session.
challenge.finding: Logout would be excessive and conflate identity with operating context.
challenge.resolution: A dedicated clear-context server action removes only tenant context and redirects to /admin/platform.

proofPlan: Add deterministic source-level regression proof for target validation, eligible-status gating, context visibility and clear behavior.
Run Quality Tests, TypeScript and Production Build.
Run Incremental Known Failure Replay and existing sync/truth gates.
Require exact-head Completion Truth VERIFIED and lifecycle closure.

requirements.requirement: Platform operations surfaces provide explicit eligible-tenant entry, visible active-context state, and clear-context return while delegating tenant truth to the canonical authority.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Browser-submitted instance ids cannot directly establish tenant context.
A platform actor operating inside a selected tenant sees the active tenant identity in the shared shell.
Clearing tenant context does not sign out or alter customer authentication.

notes: Third isolated transaction in the MR1 platform tenant-selection block. Base is the verified-core candidate branch; no DOMAIN-TENANCY implementation files are modified here.
